name: Honeycomb Cloud Tram
description: A whimsical tram shaped like golden honeycomb glides along a suspended track through peach-colored sunset clouds.
prompt: A single wide-angle fantasy illustration of a whimsical tram shaped like a giant golden honeycomb, gliding along a delicate suspended track through soft peach and lavender clouds at sunset. Glowing hexagonal windows, tiny lanterns, and friendly bees drift around. Below, a patchwork countryside with rivers and windmills. Warm cinematic light, volumetric clouds, intricate detail, storybook wonder, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: All aboard the sweetest commute in the sky. Would you ride the honeycomb cloud tram at sunset?
